headline: Gatchalian Urges DepEd to Fill 133 Disability-Support Posts
seoTitle: Gatchalian Urges DepEd to Fill 133 Support Posts | FMB News
seoDescription: Senate President Sherwin Gatchalian urged DepEd to fill 133 newly approved positions supporting programs and services for learners with disabilities.
deck: The newly approved positions include education program specialists, physical therapists and occupational therapists.
author: FMB News Desk

sections.heading: What happened
paragraphs: Senate President Sherwin Gatchalian urged the Department of Education to fill 133 newly created personnel positions intended to strengthen support and specialized services for learners with disabilities.

The Department of Budget and Management approved the new plantilla items, which include Senior Education Program Specialists, Education Program Specialist IIs, Physical Therapist IIs and Occupational Therapist IIs.

sections.heading: Context
paragraphs: Republic Act No. 11650 establishes a national policy of inclusion and services for learners with disabilities. It directs the government to support Inclusive Learning Resource Centers and provides for specialists, assessment, intervention and related services.

The source report supports the 133 approved positions and the listed job classes. It does not substantiate the bulletin's claims about speech-therapist posts, more than 300,000 affected learners, completed regional hiring pools or university recruitment partnerships, so those details are excluded.

sections.heading: Why this matters
paragraphs: Filling the posts is a concrete implementation step for the law's promise of accessible, inclusive and appropriate public education for learners with disabilities.

sections.heading: What to watch next
paragraphs: Watch for DepEd's recruitment timetable, the distribution of the 133 positions across regions and public reporting on how quickly the posts are filled.
